fields.title: Kofi Shares His Toys
fields.content: ["Kofi had a big box of shiny toy cars.", "His friend Ama had none to play with.", "Kofi felt happy when he gave Ama a red car.", "They raced their cars together all afternoon.", "Sharing made playtime twice as fun!"]
fields.life_skill_lesson: Sharing what we have helps us make friends and brings joy to everyone.

fields.title: Ama and the Soapy Bubbles
fields.content: ["Ama came inside after playing in the garden.", "Her hands were covered in dirt and germs.", "She turned on the tap and rubbed soap until it bubbled.", "She scrubbed for as long as it takes to sing a song.", "Clean hands kept Ama healthy and strong."]
fields.life_skill_lesson: Knowing when to wash our hands keeps our bodies healthy and safe.

fields.title: Whose Turn Is It?
fields.content: ["The children lined up to ride the swing.", "Little Esi wanted to go first, first, first!", "Their teacher showed them how to take turns.", "Esi waited and cheered while her friend swung high.", "When her turn came, everyone cheered for her too."]
fields.life_skill_lesson: Taking turns and waiting patiently lets everyone have a fair chance to play.

fields.title: Building the Science Bridge
fields.content: ["Yaw's class entered the school science fair as a team.", "At first, everyone wanted to build their own separate design.", "Yaw suggested they combine the best idea from each person.", "They shared tools, listened carefully, and fixed mistakes together.", "Their model bridge held the most weight and won first prize."]
fields.life_skill_lesson: When we combine everyone's strengths and listen to one another, a team can achieve far more than any single person alone.

fields.title: The Case of the Quiet Classroom
fields.content: ["The class hamster had escaped from its cage overnight.", "Instead of guessing wildly, Yaw looked for real clues.", "He noticed tiny footprints leading toward the warm heater.", "He followed the trail calmly and found the hamster asleep.", "Thinking step by step solved the mystery faster than panic."]
fields.life_skill_lesson: Looking carefully at the evidence and reasoning step by step helps us solve problems instead of just guessing.

fields.title: Esi Leads the Clean-Up
fields.content: ["The community park was covered in litter after the weekend.", "Esi did not wait to be told what to do.", "She organised her friends into small groups with clear jobs.", "She thanked each person and kept everyone encouraged.", "By evening the park was clean, and the whole team felt proud."]
fields.life_skill_lesson: A good leader takes initiative, gives others a clear role, and keeps the team encouraged until the work is finished.

fields.title: Planning the Big Week
fields.content: ["Esi had a science test and a football final in the same week.", "She wrote a simple plan that divided her time each evening.", "She studied first, then practised, and rested before bed.", "When distractions came, she remembered her goals and kept going.", "She passed her test and played her best game too."]
fields.life_skill_lesson: Planning our time and tackling the most important tasks first lets us reach several goals without feeling overwhelmed.

fields.title: Musa's Promise
fields.content: ["Musa found a wallet full of money on the crowded bus.", "No one was watching, and he could easily have kept it.", "He remembered the kind of person he truly wanted to be.", "He handed the wallet to the driver and described the owner.", "The grateful owner thanked him, and Musa felt at peace."]
fields.life_skill_lesson: Integrity means doing the right thing even when no one is watching, because our character matters more than any reward.

fields.title: A Voice for Change
fields.content: ["Musa noticed his neighbourhood had no safe place to study.", "He could have simply complained and done nothing more.", "Instead he gathered ideas and spoke calmly to the local council.", "He listened to others and proposed a small, realistic plan.", "A quiet study room opened, and many students benefited."]
fields.life_skill_lesson: When we notice a problem, taking responsible action and speaking up respectfully can create real change for our whole community.
